title: Run from a pull-request comment
description: Recipes whose result is a change pushed to a Domain pull request, asked for by a repository writer tagging @vibedata in a top-level comment. On a pull request no Vibedata Intent owns, the work arrives as a new pull request. Needs a Domain with a CI bundle (not Redshift or MotherDuck without authentication) on a non-ambient install GitHub can reach. Agent questions are answered in Studio.
